name: Ewoks
description: The Ewok Wicket and his friends from the Bright Tree Village go on many magical adventures.

videos.title: The Haunted Village
videos.overview: Morag the Tulga Witch seeks revenge on her old enemy Logray, shaman of the Ewoks, who holds the magic Sunstar while she possesses its darker half, the Shadowstone. The Witch unleashes her flying Mantigrue to destroy the Ewok's sun berry trees, turns the fire folk into forest fire spreading pyromaniacs, frames the Ewoks for the kidnapping of a baby Phlog, and kidnaps Logray's young apprentice Teebo and his friends. All this to lure her sworn enemy back to Mount Thunderstone to decide who will possess the two halves of the Sunstar/Shadowstone.

videos.title: Tales from the Endor Woods
videos.overview: 'Adult Wicket' remembers four memorable adventures from his youth: how he fixed up his great grandfather's battle wagon, the occasion when Latara ran away from the Ewok village to join the traveling Jindas, the time his father Deej feel terrible ill and the story of Kneesa's long lost sister, Asha.

videos.title: Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure
videos.overview: Focuses on the struggles of a brother and sister, stranded on the forest moon of Endor, in locating their parents, who have been kidnapped by a monster known as the Gorax.

videos.title: Ewoks: The Battle for Endor
videos.overview: A sequel to Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure, it focuses on Cindel Towani, the little girl from the first film, who, after being orphaned, joins the Ewoks in protecting their village and defeating the evil marauders who have taken control of the Endor moon.

videos.title: The Cries of the Trees
videos.overview: Wicket and his pals defend the Soul Trees when Morag tries to set the forest on fire.

videos.title: The Haunted Village
videos.overview: Invisibility soap, made to protect the Ewoks' sunberry trees, is stolen by the Duloks!

videos.title: Rampage of the Phlogs
videos.overview: Morag separates a baby Phlog from his parents and blames the Ewoks, prompting an attack.

videos.title: To Save Deej
videos.overview: When Deej is poisoned by a deadly fungus, his sons search for ingredients to brew a cure.

videos.title: The Travelling Jindas
videos.overview: Upset that her flute playing is unappreciated, Latara stows away with nomadic performers.

videos.title: The Tree of Light
videos.overview: Wicket's brothers set off to restore the Tree of Light and are joined by uninvited "guests."

videos.title: The Curse of the Jindas
videos.overview: After Jindas save the Ewoks from Skandits, Logray tries to reverse the Jindas' curse.

videos.title: The Land of the Gupins
videos.overview: After rescuing Mring-Mring and Oobel, Wicket and his friends journey to the Gupin homeland.

videos.title: Sunstar vs. Shadowstone
videos.overview: To save Teebo & his friends, Master Logray battles Morag for the Sunstar Shadowstone.

videos.title: Wicket's Wagon
videos.overview: Wicket & his brothers find an old battle wagon built by their ancestor to fight the Duloks.

videos.title: The Three Lessons
videos.overview: Chief Chirpa tries to instruct Princess Kneesaa in what it takes to be a true leader.

videos.title: Blue Harvest
videos.overview: As the Ewoks gather their annual harvest, the Duloks plot to steal their crops.

videos.title: Asha
videos.overview: Wicket watches as a mysterious defender of helpless animals thwarts Dulok hunters.

videos.title: The Crystal Cloak
videos.overview: An ambitious Wicket goes with his friends on a quest for the crystal cloak stolen by the Gracca. They end up destroying the crystal cloak instead.

videos.title: The Wish Plant
videos.overview: The leaf queen assigns Kneesa to care for a wish plant. Her friends abuse the plant with their wishes. Kneesa manages to restore the plant before the leaf queen's arrival.

videos.title: Home is Where the Shrieks Are
videos.overview: Wicket and Teebo try to live by themselves in a house inhabited by Larry the Shriek, who convinces them they are better off back at home.

videos.title: Princess Latara
videos.overview: The Gorph Queen Slugga kidnaps Latara masquerading as a princess for her son to marry. Wicket and his friends rescue Latara and trap the Gorphs.

videos.title: The Raich
videos.overview: Wicket accidentally unleashes the Raich from its tree form prison. With help from the Two-headed Gonster, Wicket and his friends trap the Raich as it was before.

videos.title: The Totem Master
videos.overview: Creatures in the guise of a totem led by the master rob the Ewok village. Wicket and his friends follow the master and destroy him along with his curse.

videos.title: A Gift for Shodu
videos.overview: Wicket and his friends venture into an ancient temple to get a jewel for Shodu's birthday. That jewels turns out to be an egg of the Scuver Dragon.

videos.title: Night of the Stranger
videos.overview: A phantom has the Duloks raid the Ewok village to steal the Sunstar. Wicket and his friends manage to prevent a phantom exodus from taking place.

videos.title: Gone With the Mimphs
videos.overview: Wicket is captured by the Mimphs after a failed hunt for a Hanadak, but then he has to rescue them from the rampaging Hanadak.

videos.title: The First Apprentice
videos.overview: Ex-Apprentice Zarrak tries to teach Teebo his secrets but tires of his failures. Wicket, his friends rescue Teebo and Teebo masters enough magic to defeat Zarrak.

videos.title: Hard Sell
videos.overview: Wicket and his friends compete selling Mooth's goods for some valuable horns, but they end up empty-handed.

videos.title: A Warrior and a Lurdo
videos.overview: Teebo flunks at Wicket's warrior training, but is asked by the Tumbles to chase away a creature named Blog. Teebo sticks with magic to destroy the Blog's dam.

videos.title: The Season Scepter
videos.overview: Pressured by Odra, the Snow King freezes the lands of Endor. Wicket and his friends restore the balance of Endor's seasons after liberating the season scepter.

videos.title: Prow Beaten
videos.overview: Wicket and his friends accidentally lose Chirpa's canoe prow carving to the Duloks. While trying to get it back, they destroy Urga's battleship.

videos.title: Baga's Rival
videos.overview: Kneesa takes in a Quarf (actually a monster) called Silky sent by Jadru to hold her ransom for the Sunstar. Wicket and Baga come to the rescue and turn the tides on Jadru.

videos.title: Horville's Hut of Horrors
videos.overview: A visit to Horville's Hut of Horrors puts the woklings into a crying fit. An attempt to hide the truth only makes Wicket regret it.

videos.title: The Tragic Flute
videos.overview: Latara gets captured by a creature who takes greedy people to be his slaves so Wicket, Kneesaa and Teebo have to rescue her but to get out Latara must pass a test.

videos.title: Just My Luck
videos.overview: Wicket experiences bad luck when he takes his warrior's test.

videos.title: Bringing Up Norky
videos.overview: To Wicket's chagrin, his family babysits the unruly Norky.

videos.title: Battle for the Sunstar
videos.overview: Doctor Raygar, a mad scientist from the Galactic Empire appears to steal the Sunstar for himself and it's up to Wicket and his friends to stop him.

videos.title: Party Ewok
videos.overview: Kneesaa's friends save her from a gang.

videos.title: Malani the Warrior
videos.overview: Malani wants to join the warrior games, but some thieves come to take the Sunstar.
